2477.title: core: str.encode never raises UnicodeEncodeError — 'café'.encode('ascii') returns b'caf?'
2477.body:
| # | cell | python | Sharpy @ 3f103e098 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `'café'.encode('ascii')` | raises `UnicodeEncodeError` | `b'caf?'` |
| 2 | `'café'.encode('ascii', 'replace')` | `b'caf?'` | expected `b'caf?'` (unmeasured: does the `errors` parameter exist?) |
| 3 | `'café'.encode('ascii', 'ignore')` | `b'caf'` | unmeasured |
| 4 | `'\udc80'.encode('utf-8')` (lone surrogate) | raises `UnicodeEncodeError` | unmeasured |
| 5 | `b'\xff'.decode('utf-8')` | raises `UnicodeDecodeError` | unmeasured; no `UnicodeDecodeError` type exists in Core |
| 6 | control: `except UnicodeError` / `except ValueError` catch cell 1 | caught | n/a until cell 1 raises |

2461.title: stdlib: CLR exceptions where Python raises ValueError (date/time/datetime constructors, numpy broadcast and reshape, np.clip asserting a throw numpy does not make)
2461.body:
**Cells measured @ 47c5b90c1 against python3 3.13.18 (numpy text from numpy's own message):**
| # | cell | python | sharpy | where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `date(2023, 2, 29)` | `ValueError: day is out of range for month` | `System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException` out of `System.DateTime..ctor`, uncaught by `except ValueError` | `Datetime.cs:14-17` |

| 5 | `np.clip(a, 5.0, 2.0)` | numpy returns an array of the max; no throw | `ArgumentException("min must not exceed max")` and `numpy_manipulation_tests.spy:247-250` asserts that throw | `Numpy.Manipulation.cs:397` |
| 6 | spy tests asserting a CLR exception type | — | 17: numpy 15 (`ArgumentException` 11, `InvalidOperationException` 3, `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` 1), datetime 2 (`ArgumentOutOfRangeException`, `datetime_date_tests.spy:142`, `datetime_tests.spy:66`); argparse's `ArgumentError` is Python's own and is not in this class | `src/Sharpy.Stdlib.Tests/Spy/**` |
| 7 | source scan `throw new (Argument\|InvalidOperation\|NotSupported\|ArgumentOutOfRange)Exception` over `src/Sharpy.Stdlib/**/*.cs` | — | 57 sites: Numpy 47, Requests 5, Yaml 3, Toml 1, TypedLoadContract 1 (`ArgumentNullException` null guards excluded: those are bug guards) | scan |

2124.title: core: except LookupError does not catch KeyError or IndexError — neither derives from LookupError
2124.body:
`try: {}['k'] except LookupError: print('caught')` → the KeyError escapes (same for `[][0]` / IndexError). python3: `caught` for both — `KeyError` and `IndexError` are subclasses of `LookupError`. The Core exception hierarchy must mirror python's (`LookupError` → `KeyError`, `IndexError`; check the rest of the builtin exception tree against `python3 -c 'import inspect; …'` in one table-driven test).

---
Found by `/verify-implementation plan-0ca7b7` core fix lane (after d6a7aef05).

| 6 | `except UnicodeError` / `except ValueError` catch cells 1 and 5 | n/a | both catch both |
